# CloudFront KeyValueStore

Read and write keys in local CloudFront key value stores.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `cloudfrontkeyvaluestore` |
| Signing name | `cloudfront-keyvaluestore` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2022-07-26` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local key/value persistence and S3 JSON imports; no edge runtime |
| Selected operations | 6 of 6 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#cloudfront-keyvaluestore) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- SDKs prefix the endpoint host with the store's account ID, so the endpoint must be a name under localhost (or another name that resolves with any prefix); an IP address endpoint cannot reach the data plane, and terraform-local points it at localhost.
- No edge replication or CloudFront Functions runtime; local writes are immediately visible.
- Stores and tags are inventoried by CloudFront; keys have no separate CloudFormation resource type.
- Invalid S3 imports expose IMPORT_FAILED in the control plane and IMPORT_FAILURE with a reason in the data plane; missing source objects fail creation explicitly.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
